column1: The Artificial Intelligence Debate|1988|0|0|1988|8,8,7,7,7,7,10,9,7,8|Stephen R. Graubard (editor)|Competing essays compare AI architectures, cognition and philosophical assumptions. Diversity of positions supplies counterarguments and useful distinctions, while the 1988 state of research limits current application. Historical arguments are not presented here as a current technical guide. https://mitpress.mit.edu/9780262570749/the-artificial-intelligence-debate/

Star Warriors|1985|10|0|1985|8,8,8,7,8,8,10,8,8,8|William J. Broad|Reported laboratory account links scientific talent, institutional incentives and weapons-development ambitions. Technology and research organization lead, with defense as the application. A narrow visit cannot establish all strategic claims; observational detail nevertheless provides distinct constraints. https://gwern.net/doc/radiance/1985-broad-starwarriors.pdf

No Ordinary Genius|1994|0|0|1988|8,6,6,6,7,9,9,8,8,8|Christopher Sykes|Documentary-based portrait uses recollections and images to explain Feynman's research habits, teaching and personal life. Science biography qualifies under the V3 exception. Anecdotes yield some reusable habits but less causal integration than a sustained intellectual history.

Feynman|2011|0|0|1988|7,6,6,6,7,9,9,7,9,7|Jim Ottaviani; Leland Myrick|Graphic biography explains scientific work through selected episodes and visual narrative. It is nonfiction despite its comic format. Reconstructed scenes simplify evidence; varied scientific and institutional episodes provide learning beyond personality alone.

Classic Feynman|2005|0|0||7,5,7,6,7,9,8,9,9,8|Richard P. Feynman|Collected autobiographical accounts and lectures expose practical reasoning, scientific skepticism and organizational failures. Episodes vary in learning yield and repeat material in other Feynman collections. Treat overlap as reading opportunity cost, not evidence of lower factual reliability.

The Quotable Feynman|2015|0|0||7,3,5,3,6,9,7,9,8,8|Richard P. Feynman; Michelle Feynman (editor)|Selected statements illuminate scientific doubt, learning and intellectual honesty. Quotations are memorable but remove context and seldom develop a complete causal account. A scientist's collected thought qualifies under the biography exception; it is not a specialist technical reference.

Most of the Good Stuff|1993|0|0|1988|8,6,6,6,7,9,9,9,7,8|Laurie M. Brown; John S. Rigden (editors)|Colleagues' recollections add perspectives on Feynman's work, teaching and scientific environment. Firsthand access is valuable but commemorative selection can favor admiration. Distinct contributors offer educational comparison with some repetition.

Infinite in All Directions|1988|0|0||7,8,7,7,7,8,9,10,8,8|Freeman Dyson|Essays connect physics, biological complexity, technology and scientific responsibility. Broad analogy supports useful questions rather than demonstrated universal laws. Speculation should be read as dated, qualified proposals; variable essays limit a single cumulative argument.

We Are All Stardust|2010|0|0||8,7,7,7,7,8,8,8,9,8|Stefan Klein|Interviews compare the working methods and unsettled questions of scientists across fields. Personal detail can clarify how research proceeds, though conversational breadth limits sustained mechanism. German original 2010; English translation 2015 does not reset age. https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/28234779-we-are-all-stardust

Carl Sagan: A Life|1999|0|0|1996|8,7,7,7,7,9,9,8,8,8|Keay Davidson|Scientific biography connects planetary research, public communication and scientific controversy. Multiple roles offer lessons about evidence and persuasion; personal chronology contributes less strategic utility. The scientist biography exception applies.

The NASA Archives|2018|10|0|2018|8,6,6,6,7,9,10,8,9,8|Piers Bizony; Andrew Chaikin; Roger Launius|Photographs and historical commentary show spacecraft development, missions and institutional ambition. Explanatory narrative makes it more than a reference index, though imagery provides less causal detail than engineering history. American institutional history incurs T11. https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/NewsNotes-36-1-Spring-2019.pdf

To the Stars|1994|10|0|1994|7,4,4,4,6,7,2,7,8,7|George Takei|Memoir links childhood internment, acting and public identity. First-person testimony supplies historical experience but little technical or strategic mechanism. Celebrity and American civil history lower fit; personal testimony alone does not establish a serious veto.

Leonard Nimoy’s I Am Spock|1995|10|0|1995|7,4,4,4,6,7,2,7,8,7|Leonard Nimoy|Memoir examines a performer's relation to a role, collaboration and public expectations. It offers limited lessons about creative identity but is mostly celebrity recollection. The television setting is not evidence of scientific subject matter.

The Good Neighbor|2018|10|10|2003|8,6,6,6,7,8,3,8,8,8|Maxwell King|Biography connects children's broadcasting, educational choices and production culture. Interviews and archival evidence support lessons about audience trust and institutional practice. American media personality and media production incur both thematic deductions.

The World According to Mister Rogers|2003|10|0||7,3,4,3,5,8,1,7,8,8|Fred Rogers|Collected reflections cover respect, emotional development and communication. Useful distinctions survive removal of personality, but short sayings provide little evidence or system explanation. The collection's authority rests heavily on a television educator.

Seeing and Believing|1998|0|0|1996|8,8,7,8,8,9,10,8,9,8|Richard Panek|Explains how improved optical instruments changed astronomical evidence and interpretation. The author's opening excerpt distinguishes available components from their scientific use; successive discoveries add new constraints. Hubble-era endpoint 1996 is approximate. https://www.richardpanek.net/_b__i_seeing_and_believing__how_the_telescope_opened_our_eyes_and_minds_to_the_he_127987.htm

Mating in Captivity|2006|0|0||6,5,5,5,6,7,1,8,8,7|Esther Perel|Clinical cases examine the tension between intimacy, security and desire. Cases generate hypotheses and useful distinctions but do not establish broadly valid causal effects. Recurrent relationship scenarios offer applications with limited domain fit.

Adventures of a Reckless Amateur|2014|0|0||7,3,4,3,6,7,2,7,7,7|Sverre Aarseth|An astronomer's mountaineering and travel memoir, not an account of numerical stellar dynamics. It offers some lessons about persistence and risk but little technical explanation. The science-biography exception is applied cautiously; sporting travel remains a poor fit. Author's institutional obituary confirms the 2014 book and scope. https://www.ast.cam.ac.uk/news/sverre-aarseth-20-july-1934-28-december-2024
